2:225.text: Allāh does not impose blame upon you for what is unintentional in your oaths, but He imposes blame upon you for what your hearts have earned. And Allāh is Forgiving and Forbearing.

2:226.text: For those who swear not to have sexual relations with their wives
is a waiting time of four months, but if they return
- then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

2:227.text: And if they decide on divorce - then indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
